prompts.prompt: Which one-night escape would feel more magical?

A lantern boat on a silent lake

prompts.prompt: Which secret date would you rather discover?
options: A hidden rooftop dinner above the city
A candlelit picnic inside an old greenhouse

prompts.prompt: Which imaginary home sounds more like us?
options: A compact house beside a wild beach
A warm apartment above a tiny bakery

prompts.prompt: Which slow morning would you choose?
options: Breakfast on a mountain balcony
Coffee beside a rain-covered window

prompts.prompt: Which creative adventure would be more fun?
options: Making a short film in one weekend
Recording an album of ridiculous love songs

prompts.prompt: Which midnight experience calls to you?
options: Swimming in a safely lit rooftop pool
Walking through an all-night flower market

prompts.prompt: Which year-long experiment would you try?
options: A monthly date chosen by alternating surprise

Following one food tradition across a region

options: A private feast cooked by close friends
A two-person trip with no announced itinerary

prompts.prompt: Which shared workspace would inspire us?

A quiet library room with a fireplace

prompts.prompt: Which gentle luxury would you choose for a month?

A nightly hour with every device turned off

A sheltered cove reached by a winding stair

Choosing a completely new place for every milestone

options: A masked dance in a floating palace
A midnight feast in an enchanted orchard

Taking a beginner climbing lesson together

Living within walking distance of every daily need

options: Dancing alone after everyone else has left
Talking until sunrise over a shared dessert
